post.summary: Import GTFS paths and service calendars, with optional API preview
post.description: Requires the existing Editor policy and browser CSRF protection. Omitted sourceId resolves a durable private provider binding from canonical agency URLs, ignoring optional agency IDs, publisher metadata, names, dates, feed versions and archive names. A unique exact legacy route/shape and geometry match preserves prior UUIDs; ambiguous matches return 409. Missing agency URLs require an explicit operator sourceId. Explicit namespaces remain supported and are never redirected or rebound. Parent identity is (sourceId, route_id); child identity is (sourceId, route_id, shape_id). Missing bindings are retained and suppression is preserved. Result counters distinguish parents from paths.

requestBody.description: ZIP at most 25 MiB; complete request at most 26 MiB. Failed validation writes nothing. Omit sourceId for automatic provider identification; supply a stable explicit namespace for operator reconciliation. preview=true validates without saving data or provider bindings.

sourceId.description: Optional explicit stable provider namespace. Omit for automatic agency URL identification. A supplied empty or invalid value is rejected. Explicit imports may establish an unbound provider-to-namespace mapping, but never rebind existing mappings.

post.summary: Restore an individually suppressed child using its parent version
post.description: Requires Editor and browser CSRF. The path must belong to the specified active parent; restore a suppressed parent first. Uses the observed parent version and returns the updated parent with paths[]. Retains path UUID, source binding and calendars and queues conflict evaluation. Stale versions or a suppressed parent return 409; an unknown parent/path pair returns 404.

delete.summary: Delete an individual route path using its parent version
delete.description: Requires Editor and browser CSRF. Soft-deletes only the child path by marking it suppressed, retaining its UUID, source binding, calendars and historical alert evidence. The specified parent must be active and remains active even when its final active path is deleted; without active paths it contributes no map or conflict-detection geometry. Uses the observed parent version, queues conflict evaluation and returns the updated parent with paths[] and its new version. Repeating with the current parent version is idempotent. Reimports preserve the suppression; the existing child restore endpoint can restore it. Missing version returns 400 (routes.version.required), stale version returns 409 (routes.conflict), a suppressed parent returns 409 (routes.suppressed), and an unknown or mismatched parent/path pair returns 404 (routes.paths.notFound).

Route.description: Stable route parent. Child paths retain separate geometry versions, source coverage and calendars; there is no merged parent geometry or calendar. Parent version protects aggregate writes.

RouteWrite.description: Manual route aggregate. Provide paths or legacy flat geometry, never both. Flat validity fields apply to the single legacy child; flat updates are supported only for a route with one child. PUT requires the observed parent version. Existing children omitted from paths are removed; historical alert evidence is retained. Imported routes cannot be manually edited.

pathId.description: Stable affected child path ID; absent or null in legacy evidence.

pathTitle.description: Child path title captured with this evidence; absent or null in legacy evidence.

ConflictPath.description: Only an affected child version and its own availability are included. Legacy immutable snapshots may omit pathId and pathTitle.

routeId.description: Parent route UUID for grouped evidence. Immutable legacy evidence retains its original route identity.

RouteConflictDetails.description: One potential conflict per rule, parent route and construction site. Each affected child is evaluated using its own calendar; disjoint overlap periods are retained.

lastEvaluatedAt.description: Time of the last actual successful detector evaluation, including assessed partitions with no matches. Queue completion and paused work do not refresh this timestamp.

pausedTypes.description: Distinct disabled rule types; retained cases remain visible while their evaluation is paused.

evidenceRevisions.description: Retained revisions available through the evidence endpoint.

supersededByAlertId.description: Canonical case for a superseded, read-only history. Null for a current case.

relatedAlerts.description: Linked retained cases, including the canonical target where applicable. Reviewer decisions and evidence remain on their original cases.

RoutePath.description: Named child path with a stable UUID and its own geometry/calendar versions. It is active only when both parent and child are not suppressed.

id.description: Omit for a new child. On update, use a unique child ID belonging to this parent to retain that child. IDs are forbidden on create.
